name: Projects
summary: Partition by active deliverable or codebase. Use when most content belongs to a discrete piece of work with a lifecycle.
when_to_use: There are repos, builds, demos, or client engagements in the corpus.
Each cluster has its own tooling (scripts, configs, vendored deps).
The owner speaks in project names.
partitioning_rubric: A project folder is self-contained: its scripts, data, and notes move together. Never split a project's internal structure.
Detect project-ness by signals: README, package/pyproject files, .git dirs, scripts/ layout. Respect the project's internal layout — move it whole.
Active projects get STATE.md; finished ones become kind=archive with a README saying so.
Shared utilities used by 2+ projects stay at top level (scripts/, data/) or get promoted to their own project.

folder_template.agents_md_skeleton:
# <Project>

## What this is
<one paragraph>

## How to work on it
- <build/test/run commands if any>

## STATE.md
Track current status and next moves here.

example.lead-gen: keyless CPG lead-gen pipeline, orchestrator + importers
example.yolo-world-cpu-demo: ONNX export demo for CPU inference
